effects.actual_behavior: Native attack attribute base10; attack amount float(int(current total ATTACK_DAMAGE)), preserving integer truncation. Within target.width+actor.width+2: Bite frame4 and Tail frame6 both request mobAttack(this); Drowned/Guardian doubles bite/tail amount separately, not jump hit. Hurt result gates only attack sound. Tail knockback1 occurs independently of hurt acceptance; then addY=clamp(1-ORCA.getAttributeValue(KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE),0,1)*.4F to target, using attacker resistance (base.7F), not victim resistance. doHurtTarget chooses tail50% only water/bubble, else bite; returns true after setting animation. Jump goal only target, water/notground/native jumpCooldown and exposed water surface; distanceXZ²<150 -> deltaXZ=(target-source)*.3*clamp(absdiff,0,1)*.3, Y=1+randomFloat*.8, cooldown64+rand32; farther native navigation1. Jump tick targetdistance<3 and attackCooldown<=0 -> onJumpHit with current truncation (no2xspecial target), cooldown20; else dist<5 setsBite. Goal stop attackCooldown0, jumpCooldown decrements native tick. These are distinct original requests, not duplicate Stage damage. Attacking Player strips OrcasMight from current target independently. Native tamable superclass owns state; no custom tame interaction shown, no invented player owner. Native targets retaliation-alert peers, babyCachalotWhale25 and ORCA_TARGETS tag200. Animation setters retain current raw field only, pinned Citadel clock owns advance/end, not invented reset on every set.
